title: AGF Hero Section
description: Landing section schema for the AGF brand experience, defining the giant Monoton mark, the Commissioner top tagline, the Poiret strapline, supporting subheadline, proof-point metrics, and immersive background treatments.

mark.description: The giant brand mark rendered in Monoton on the left of the hero stage (typically 'AGF'). Drives the height of the taglines column to its right.

headline.description: Top-aligned tagline in Commissioner at 25% the height of the mark. Sits to the right of the mark, flush with its top.

strapline.description: Bottom-aligned tagline in Poiret One at 15% the height of the mark. Sits to the right of the mark, flush with its bottom. The 'tagline underneath' beat.

subheadline.description: Supporting subheadline that contextualizes the headline.

metrics.description: Quantitative proof-points displayed beneath the headline.

value.description: Numeric or string value for the metric (string allows ranges, e.g., '4-6').

suffix.description: Optional unit or qualifier appended to the value (e.g., 'B', '%', 'mo').

appendix.description: markdown — supporting notes for the appendix

background_type.description: Visual treatment behind the hero content.

scroll_indicator.description: Whether to show an animated scroll affordance.

pcb_motif.description: Whether to overlay the printed-circuit-board engraved motif.
